facts.fact: Le Sahel reports that the Projet Villages Intelligents held an official ceremony on 6 May 2026 inaugurating the broadband connectivity of the mairies, delivered to the town halls by the project with the communications minister present; it gives no number of mairies.
facts.system: connectivité haut débit des mairies (Projet Villages Intelligents)

facts.fact: The broadband connectivity of the mairies under the Projet Villages Intelligents was officially received at a ceremony on 6 May 2026, in the presence of the communications minister and the World Bank's resident representative.
facts.system: connectivité haut débit des mairies (Projet Villages Intelligents)

facts.fact: At the 6 May 2026 ceremony the World Bank's resident representative said the Bank finances the infrastructure and will support capacity building to sustain the investment; the document names no domestic budget line for the mairies' connectivity.
facts.system: connectivité haut débit des mairies (Projet Villages Intelligents)
